product_metadata.title: 4 Pack Ice Cube Trays, Ice Tray Durable & Flexible, Ice Trays for Freezer, Silicone Ice Cube Tray, 14 Ice Cube Trays for Freezer With Lid, Super Easy Release Stackable BPA Free for Drinks & Cocktail
features: NEVER RUN OUT OF ICE: Making ice cubes is easy with our premium plastic trays! Easy to use, practical and versatile, these ice cubes trays allow you to freezer 14 ice cubes per tray, so you can enjoy a refreshing, ice-cold beverage.

EASY TO USE: JISLA all you have to do to enjoy fresh ice is add water to the orange ice cubes trays and place them in the freezer. After a few short hours, take the lid off the plastic ice cube trays and pop out the ice with a single move.

MADE TO LAST: Our ice cube trays with lids are made with an extra-thick plastic that can withstand very low temperatures. The ice trays are quite flexible, which allows you to pop out the cubes easier and quicker.

STACKABLE DESIGN: These covered ice cube trays come with practical lids, which allows you to stack them in the freezer and save tons of space. The lids also keep the freezer smell and taste out of the water, so you can enjoy clear and clean ice cubes.

USE THEM YOUR WAY: Our ice tray with lid is great for clear ice cubes, but can also be used for make many summer delicacies such as popsicles, puddings, and fruit jellies. The set includes 4 large ice trays for a total of 56 cubes. They are food-grade and BPA-free, as well as dishwasher safe.
